problem.title: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair of Parentheses

approaches.title: Stack-based substring reversal
approaches.summary: Uses a stack to track opening parentheses and reverses the enclosed byte range when each closing parenthesis is encountered. Revision 2 retains this strategy while building the result directly instead of filtering an in-place buffer.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Tracks opening-parenthesis positions on a stack and reverses each matched byte slice in place, then removes parentheses.

revisions.commitBody:
previous method did the reversals in-place. No point doing that since
result requires a new vector anyway
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Builds the result buffer directly and reverses its suffix at each closing parenthesis, avoiding a separate final filtering pass.

approaches.title: Parenthesis-pair traversal
approaches.summary: Precomputes matching parenthesis indices, then traverses the input while changing direction at each pair to emit characters in reversed order. This avoids repeatedly reversing nested slices and achieves linear traversal after pair construction.

revisions.commitBody:
multiple nested parentheses cause redundant reversals and iterate whole
slices multiple times, resulting in O(n^2) time complexity.

this only iterates once to build the pair mapping, and a second time to
collect the chars in correct order
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Precomputes matching pairs and uses direction-switching traversal to collect characters without repeated substring reversals.
